welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body:
This app gets the internet (PPPoE) username and password for your Yettel line, so you can use your own router.
You need the label of your router: serial number, MAC address and Wi-Fi key.
The app saves credentials on this computer. The provider may change router management settings during a session.

help.title: Help
device.title: Router {serial}
device.delete.body: This removes the saved profile and internet settings for {serial} from this computer. It does not change anything on the router or at the provider.
device.replace.body: The saved management credentials may have been changed by the provider. Replacing them with the key from the label may stop the next session from working.
connect.body:
The app will now contact Yettel's management server and identify itself as your router ({serial}).

- The server may send new management credentials for the router. They are saved on this computer.
- If your original router is still connected, the provider may reconfigure it or ask it to reconnect.
- You can cancel at any time with Esc. Changes the server has already made stay in effect.
result.iptv: TV / IPTV needs a separate setup. See the guide: {url}
result.setup.three: 3. If your fiber box sends tagged traffic, set VLAN ID {vlan}. If not, leave VLAN off. Do not tag twice.
result.setup.four: 4. Set MTU to {mtu}, save, and check that the router connects.

cli.need_terminal: An interactive terminal is required. Open a terminal and run yettel-cwmp; --help and --version also work with redirected input.
cli.usage:
Yettel CWMP - portable terminal application

Usage: yettel-cwmp [--state-dir DIR] [--lang en|sr]
       yettel-cwmp --help | --version

Use only your own router and subscription.
Storage: --state-dir, or the OS user data path with a yettel-cwmp subdirectory.
Guide: https://github.com/stlk0/yettel-cwmp#readme.
error.IN-SERIAL: Check the serial number: 6–64 letters and digits.
error.IN-MAC: Check the MAC address: 12 characters, 0–9 and A–F.
error.IN-KEY: Enter the Wi-Fi key from the label.
error.IN-TEXT: Enter one value without line breaks, up to 1024 characters.
error.PR-EXISTS: This router is already saved. To use a different key, open it and choose "Change Wi-Fi key".
error.PR-CONFLICT: This serial number is already saved with a different MAC address. Check the label, or delete the saved router first.
error.PR-MISSING: This router is not saved. Check the serial number or add the router first.
error.PR-INVALID: This saved router can't be read. Delete this router and add it again.
error.NO-EXPORT: No saved settings, or the saved file is damaged. Choose "Receive internet settings" (R).
error.PR-LOCKED: The app is open in another window. Close the other window and try again.
error.ST-ACCESS: The app can't access its data folder. Check that you own this folder, or choose another one with --state-dir.
error.ST-SPACE: The disk is full. Free some disk space and try again.
error.ST-OTHER: Can't read or save app data. Try again. If it keeps happening, report it with the error code.
error.NET-DNS: Can't find the provider's server. Check that this computer is connected to the internet.
error.NET-CONNECT: Can't connect to the provider's server. Check the internet connection. The server may be busy; try again later.
error.NET-TIMEOUT: The provider's server is not responding. Try again later.
error.NET-OTHER: The connection was interrupted. Try again.
error.TLS-PIN: The provider's server identity did not match. No credentials were sent over this connection. Download the latest version: {releases_url}
error.TLS-HANDSHAKE: A secure connection could not be made. Try again later. If it keeps happening, download the latest version.
error.ACS-AUTH: The provider rejected the router credentials. If the provider set them earlier, try again later before replacing them. Otherwise, check the case-sensitive Wi-Fi key on the label and choose "Change Wi-Fi key" (K).
error.ACS-HTTP: The provider's server returned an error ({n}). Try again later.
error.ACS-PROTOCOL: The provider's server sent an unexpected response. Try again later. If it keeps happening, report it with the error code.
error.ACS-INCOMPLETE: The provider did not send the internet username and password. Try again later. If it keeps happening, your line may use different settings; contact your provider.
error.CANCELLED: Cancelled. Changes the provider already made stay in effect.
error.SESSION-TIMEOUT: The session took too long. Try again later.
error.TERM: The terminal stopped responding. Run the app in a regular terminal window.
error.INTERNAL: Something went wrong inside the app. Please report it with the error code: {issues_url}
